name: em-crm-mobile
description: Capacitor shell for Elevated Movements CRM

scripts.add:android: npm run build && cap add android
scripts.add:ios: npm run build && cap add ios && node scripts/fix-ios-package-paths.mjs
scripts.sync: npm run build && cap sync && node scripts/fix-ios-package-paths.mjs
scripts.sync:android: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.sync:ios: npm run build && cap sync ios && node scripts/fix-ios-package-paths.mjs
